newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, fails to find direction.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, fails to find direction.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia closed untraded on Monday, failing to find direction after last week's volatile dealings.
July Brent was last quoted on SIMEX at $19.34/$19.35 per barrel, down from London's settlement on Friday at $19.40.
Brokers said the market is stumbling to find direction after a volatile week last week and that most players were content to sit and wait for the overnight markets in London and New York.
NYMEX July crude was last traded at $20.89 per barrel, just one cent up from its Friday close in New York.
